title: Marge & Rose on Sidewalk, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot from the 1940s depicting two young women, annotated at the top margin as 'Marge - Rose', standing together on a residential sidewalk. Both are styled in classic 1940s WWII-era dresses, dark pumps, and victory roll-inspired hairstyles. The background reveals a neighborhood street lined with wooden utility poles, detached houses, and a period automobile.
